d: Vladimir Putin is making a fresh push to expand Russia’s influence in the Arctic. Moscow is offering tax breaks, cheaper leases and lower payroll contributions to attract businesses and investors to the region. A major part of the strategy centres on sea routes like the Northern Sea Route, which runs along Russia’s northern coast and provides a shorter shipping link between Asia and Europe. The route has become increasingly important to Russia since the Ukraine war and Western sanctions pushed Moscow to look for new energy customers in Asia, especially China.
